description: Road network shpfiles is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Haochen Shi. This data contains the road network of 20 Chinese cities, including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Xi'an, Harbin, Jinan, Kunming, Nanjing, Chongqing, Qingdao, Changsha, Chengdu, Tianjin, Shenyang, Zhengzhou, Dalian and Fuzhou. The data are presented as shapefiles with WGS84 coordinate system. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 63257722 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
